Schnittstelle MemoisingFun<X,Y>

Typparameter:
X - the input type
Y - the output type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Applicable<X,Y>, Deferrable<X,Y>, Fun<X,Y>, Function<X,Y>
public interface MemoisingFun<X,Y> extends Fun<X,Y>

A functional interface for memoized functions. Caches results by input to avoid repeated computation on identical arguments.

Contract:

  • Inputs must not be null and results must not be null.
  • The wrapped computation SHOULD be referentially transparent (pure): for equal inputs it must always produce equal results and must not rely on or cause observable side effects. Using non‑pure/side‑effecting functions with memoization can yield stale or misleading cached values and is discouraged.
  • The cache is unbounded and keyed by the input's equality semantics (Object.equals(Object) and Object.hashCode()).

Concurrency: the implementation returned by memoisingFun(Function) is thread‑safe and uses a ConcurrentHashMap. Cache inserts are atomic via ConcurrentMap.computeIfAbsent(Object, java.util.function.Function).

1.0.0

  • Methodendetails

    • memoisingFun

      static <X,Y> MemoisingFun<X,Y> memoisingFun(@NonNull Function<X,Y> function)

      Erzeugt eine neue MemoisingFun-Instanz aus einer gegebenen Function, die Creates a memoizing wrapper over the given Function. The returned function caches results for previously seen inputs and returns cached values on subsequent calls with equal inputs.

      Contract:

      • function must not be null; inputs must not be null; the wrapped function must not return null.
      • The wrapped function SHOULD be pure/referentially transparent. Applying memoization to non‑pure functions can cause surprising behaviour (e.g., missing side effects or outdated values) and is therefore not recommended.
      • The cache is unbounded and uses the input's equals/hashCode for keying.
      • Thread‑Safety: the returned implementation is thread‑safe (based on ConcurrentHashMap).
      Typparameter:
      X - the input type
      Y - the output type
      Parameter:
      function - the function to memoize; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a memoizing function wrapper
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - falls function oder deren Resultat null ist
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • clear

      MemoisingFun<X,Y> clear()

      Clears all cached results so that subsequent calls recompute values instead of returning cached ones.

      Gibt zurück:
      this MemoisingFun instance (for method chaining)
